cases.situation: My college friend Mia invited me to her bachelorette in Tulum, about $1,800 all in. Can't afford it and honestly we're not that close anymore. Want to message her directly, not the group chat.
cases.reply: Thank you for including me, Mia, it sounds like an amazing trip. I can't make Tulum this time. I'll be cheering from here, and I hope it's the best weekend.
cases.note: No reason given: 'can't afford it' invites a discount offer, and no alternative is proposed because you wouldn't go on another date either.

cases.situation: 部门老大刘总周五晚上请大家吃饭唱K，我那天要去机场接出差回来的老公，而且本来也不太想去。想私聊跟他说一声。
cases.reply: 谢谢刘总请客！周五晚上我要去机场接人，这次就不去了，祝大家玩得开心。周一见！
cases.note: 一个真实、简短的理由就够了，不用解释自己本来也不太想去；本来就不想去，也别说“下次算我一个”。

cases.situation: Told my Aunt Carol I can't come to Thanksgiving this year because we're doing it with my husband's family. She replied 'it won't be the same without you, can't you at least come for dessert?'
cases.reply: I really can't this year, Aunt Carol, and I'll miss being there. Can I call you that afternoon and say hi to everyone?
cases.note: When they push, repeat the no once and add no new reasons; new reasons are new things to negotiate.

cases.situation: Unsere neue Nachbarin, Frau Becker, hat uns für Sonntag, den 4. Oktober, zum Kaffee eingeladen. Da sind wir bei meinen Schwiegereltern in Kassel, aber wir würden sie wirklich gern kennenlernen. Ich will ihr eine Karte in den Briefkasten werfen.
cases.reply: Liebe Frau Becker, vielen Dank für die nette Einladung! Am Sonntag, den 4. Oktober, schaffen wir es nicht, da sind wir bei der Familie in Kassel. Wir würden Sie aber sehr gern kennenlernen: Hätten Sie Lust, am Sonntag, den 11. Oktober, gegen 15 Uhr zu uns auf einen Kaffee zu kommen? Herzliche Grüße, Anna und Jonas Hoffmann aus dem 2. Stock
cases.note: Wer an einem anderen Tag gern käme, schlägt einen konkreten Termin vor; so ist klar, dass das Nein nur dem Datum gilt.

cases.situation: Meu ex-colega Rafael me convidou para o lançamento da startup dele na quinta, 8 de outubro, às 19h. Nesse dia tenho aula da pós até as 22h, mas queria muito prestigiar ele.
cases.reply: Rafa, que notícia boa, parabéns! Na quinta não consigo, tenho aula da pós até as 22h. Mas quero muito ver isso de perto: posso te pagar um café na terça, dia 13, ou na quarta, dia 14, e você me mostra tudo com calma?
cases.note: Como a pessoa iria em outro dia, o convite recusado vira uma proposta concreta com duas datas.

cases.situation: I've been going to a monthly book club with some neighbours for two years and I'm just not into it anymore. Priya is hosting the next one on Thursday October 8 and asked who's coming. I want to step out for good, not make an excuse every month.
cases.reply: Thanks for hosting on the 8th, Priya. I'm going to step back from book club from now on; I've loved our evenings, it just isn't fitting my life at the moment. Have a great night, and I'll see you all around the street.
cases.note: Stepping out of a recurring thing: say it once, for good, with no alternative offered, so you are not declining every month.

cases.situation: Another mum from my son's class, Rachel, invited Noah to her daughter Ava's birthday at a trampoline park on Saturday October 10. He has a football tournament all day. The kids get on well and I'd like to keep it friendly. Replying on WhatsApp.
cases.reply: Thanks so much for inviting Noah, Rachel. He has a football tournament all day on the 10th, so we can't make it, and he'll be gutted. Would Ava like to come to ours for a play after school one day the week after? Hope she has a brilliant birthday.
cases.note: You'd happily say yes on another day, so the no comes with one concrete alternative; one true reason, no second apology.

cases.situation: 前同事小何11月14号周六在成都办婚礼，给我发了电子请柬。我们两年前一起做过项目，我离职后基本没联系了。我在深圳，不打算去，但想礼数周到一点，准备随个红包。
cases.reply: 小何，恭喜恭喜！谢谢你还想着我，收到请柬挺开心的。11月14号我去不了成都，没法到现场喝你们的喜酒了。红包刚在微信上转给你，一点心意，祝你们新婚快乐、白头偕老！
cases.note: 不太熟的婚礼：不用编理由，一句“去不了”加一份心意就够了，人不到礼到是很常见的体面做法；不需要再补一句道歉。

cases.situation: My ex, Daniel, and I dated for four years and stayed friendly after we split in 2022. He just sent me an invite to his wedding on Saturday November 21. I'm genuinely happy for him, but I don't want to go.
cases.reply: Daniel, thank you for inviting me, it really means a lot that you'd want me there. I won't be coming on the 21st, but I'm so happy for you. I hope it's a brilliant day.
cases.note: No reason and no alternative date, because you wouldn't go on any date; the warmth does the work, and there's no second apology.

cases.situation: My friend Jess asked me to be one of her bridesmaids for her wedding on June 12 next year. I'd love to go as a guest, but the dress, the hen weekend and all the planning are more than I can take on right now. I want to say no to the role, not the wedding.
cases.reply: Jess, I'm so touched you asked me, it really means a lot. I'm going to say no to being a bridesmaid, it's more than I can take on right now. I'll absolutely be there on June 12, probably crying in the third row. If there's one small job I can take off your plate nearer the day, like the table plan, I'd love to.
cases.note: Declining a role rather than the event: separate the two in the first lines so the no doesn't read as a no to the friendship.

cases.situation: Three weeks ago I RSVP'd yes to my former colleague Laura's product meetup on Tuesday October 20. A client deadline has since landed that week and I now know I can't go. We're on good terms and I want to tell her early. LinkedIn message.
cases.reply: Laura, I said yes to the meetup on the 20th, but I can't make it after all: a client deadline has landed that week. I'm telling you now so you can give my spot to someone else. I hope the night goes brilliantly.
cases.note: Backing out of a yes: tell them as soon as you know, give the one true reason once, and make it easy to fill your place; no second apology.

cases.situation: 高中毕业二十年聚会，班长在群里@我，10月24日周六在老家县城办，问我去不去。我在广州，跟大部分同学早就没联系了，也不太想去。想私聊回班长。
cases.reply: 班长，谢谢你张罗这么大一场，还特意@我。24号的聚会我就不去了，祝大家聚得开心！多拍点照片发群里，我也看看大家现在的样子。
cases.note: 不想去就不必编理由；也不提改天再聚，因为换个日子你也不会去，热情放在祝福和照片上就够了。

cases.situation: 姑妈要把她同事的儿子介绍给我，约了国庆10月3号中午一起吃饭，已经跟人家说好了。我现在不想相亲，也不想让她下不来台。
cases.reply: 姑妈，谢谢您惦记我，还特意帮我张罗。3号那顿饭我就不去了，我现在没打算相亲，您帮我跟对方说声不好意思。改天我单独陪您吃顿饭。
cases.note: 不想相亲就别说“那天有事”，否则换个日子还会再约；一个真实理由说一次，温度放在对姑妈本人身上。

cases.situation: 取引先の中村部長から、10月17日（土）のゴルフコンペに誘われました。ゴルフはほとんどやらないので行きたくないですが、関係は大事にしたいです。来月、打ち合わせで先方の会社に伺う予定があります。メールで返事をします。
cases.reply:
中村部長
いつもお世話になっております。10月17日のゴルフコンペにお声がけいただき、ありがとうございます。今回は参加を見送らせていただきます。ゴルフはほとんど経験がなく、皆さんのプレーの足を引っ張ってしまいそうです。来月御社に伺う際、よろしければランチをご一緒させてください。当日が好天に恵まれますように。
田中
cases.note: 取引先への断りは理由を一つだけ短く伝え、本当に行ける場を代わりに一つ具体的に出す。謝罪は重ねない。

cases.situation: My friend Leanne from my Tuesday yoga class invited me to a 'wellness evening' at her house on Thursday October 8. It's really her selling essential oils for a direct-sales company. I like her a lot, but I don't want to go or buy anything.
cases.reply: Thanks for the invite, Leanne. I'm going to skip Thursday, oils just aren't my thing. Hope it's a great night! Fancy a coffee after class on Tuesday?
cases.note: Decline the event, not the friend: one short honest reason, and a plan with her that has nothing to sell. If she pushes, repeat the no once.

cases.situation: My friend Callum is turning 40 and invited a group to a whisky tasting on Saturday October 17. I stopped drinking in the spring and I don't want to spend the night explaining it or watching everyone get merry. I'd happily celebrate with him another way.
cases.reply: Callum, thanks for including me, and happy almost-40! I'm going to skip the whisky tasting on the 17th. I'd love to take you out for a birthday breakfast instead, my treat. Does Sunday the 25th work, or the weekend after?
cases.note: No reason needed, and you don't owe anyone your sobriety story; a plan without alcohol shows the no is about the event, not him.

cases.situation: Two weeks ago I told my friend Chloe 'maybe' for her 30th birthday dinner on Saturday October 24. She's booking the restaurant and needs final numbers by Friday. I've since realised it's the same weekend as my sister's hen do, so I definitely can't go.
cases.reply: Chloe, sorry for leaving you on a maybe. I can't make the 24th, it's my sister's hen weekend, so please don't count me in. I'd love to take you for a birthday drink the week after instead. How's Thursday the 29th?
cases.note: A maybe makes the host plan around you, so turn it into a clear no before their deadline; one sorry for the delay, then a concrete date.

cases.situation: 表姐住成都，听说我11月10日到13日去成都出差，热情地让我住她家。我想住公司订的酒店，出差早出晚归方便些，也自在；但很想见她，11月11日周三晚上有空。
cases.reply: 表姐，谢谢你惦记我，还想着让我住家里。这次我就住公司订的酒店了，出差早出晚归，住那边方便一些。11号周三晚上我有空，请你吃顿饭好不好？
cases.note: 只拒绝“住”，不拒绝人：一个理由就够，再给一个具体的见面时间，让对方知道你是想见她的。

cases.situation: Mi prima Carmen se casa el 12 de diciembre en Oviedo y la invitación es solo para mí, sin mi pareja, Luis, con quien vivo desde hace cuatro años. Yo vivo en Málaga y no me apetece ir sola tan lejos. No quiero quejarme de lo del acompañante ni montar un drama familiar.
cases.reply: Carmen, ¡muchísimas gracias por la invitación, qué ilusión que os caséis! No podré ir el 12 de diciembre a Oviedo, pero os tendré muy presentes ese día. La próxima vez que paséis por Málaga, Luis y yo os invitamos a cenar para celebrarlo como se merece. Un abrazo enorme a los dos.
cases.note: No se menciona lo del acompañante: ese motivo abriría una negociación o un conflicto; basta un no claro y un plan cálido.

cases.situation: My coworker Ade invited me on Slack to his church's harvest service on Sunday October 11, with lunch after. I'm not religious and don't want to go, but I like him and would happily have lunch with him another time.
cases.reply: Thanks for inviting me, Ade, that's kind of you. I'll pass on Sunday, church isn't really my thing, but I hope the harvest service goes well. Fancy lunch one day this week instead? Thursday works for me.
cases.note: One short, honest reason with no debate about belief, and a real alternative because you'd genuinely like to see him.

cases.situation: My 8-year-old, Maisie, has been invited to her friend Harper's birthday sleepover on Saturday 17 October. We don't do sleepovers yet, but Maisie would love to go to the party part in the evening. Harper's mum is Kirsty; I'm replying by text.
cases.reply: Thanks so much for inviting Maisie, Kirsty, she's thrilled. We're not doing sleepovers yet, so she won't stay the night, but she'd love to come to the party part on the 17th if that works for you. What time would suit for pick-up?
cases.note: State the family rule, not a reason to debate, and say yes to the part you can do.

cases.situation: My former manager Graham's wife, Anne, died last week, and he emailed to invite me to her memorial service in Edinburgh on Friday 9 October. I worked for him for six years and Anne was always lovely to me at the team barbecues she hosted. I live in Toronto now and can't travel for it.
cases.reply: Dear Graham, I'm so sorry about Anne, and thank you for letting me know about the service on Friday 9 October. I won't be able to come over from Toronto, and I'm sad to miss the chance to remember her with you. I still think of how warm she was to all of us at those team barbecues. I'll be thinking of you on the day, and I'd love to give you a call in a few weeks, whenever suits you.
cases.note: For a memorial, the no is one clause; the space goes to the person who died and the one left behind.

cases.situation: Mon amie Claire joue dans une pièce de théâtre amateur et m'a invitée à la première, le samedi 10 octobre à 20h. Ce soir-là je garde mes neveux, mais la pièce se joue tous les samedis jusqu'au 24 octobre et j'ai vraiment envie de la voir sur scène.
cases.reply: Claire, merci pour l'invitation, je suis tellement contente pour toi ! Je ne pourrai pas venir à la première le 10, je garde mes neveux ce soir-là. Mais je ne veux pas rater ça : je viens le samedi 17, et on prend un verre après si tu as un moment.
cases.note: Une autre date seulement parce qu'elle a vraiment envie d'y aller ; sinon, un mot chaleureux suffit.

cases.situation: 我在公司做采购。供应商的王经理约我10月9日周五晚上吃饭，说是感谢今年的合作。我们员工手册规定采购岗不能接受供应商宴请。他人不错，下个月他还要来我们公司对年度合同，我想维持好关系。
cases.reply: 王经理，谢谢您的邀请，也谢谢这一年的配合。10月9日的饭我就不去了，我们员工手册规定采购岗不能接受供应商宴请，这个我得守着。下个月您来公司对年度合同，结束后我请您在楼下喝杯咖啡，咱们好好聊聊明年的计划。
cases.note: The policy is the one reason, stated once; check whether your policy also covers small treats before offering the coffee.

cases.situation: My friend Jade invited me to her baby shower on Saturday October 17. My husband and I are in the middle of IVF and I can't face a room full of baby games right now, but I haven't told Jade about the IVF and don't want to. I'm genuinely happy for her and would like to drop a gift round to her place next week.
cases.reply: Jade, thank you so much for the invite. I can't make the shower on the 17th, but I'm so happy for you. Could I drop a little something round for the baby one evening next week?
cases.note: A private reason can stay private: 'I can't make it' is a complete and true answer, and the gift shows the no isn't about her.

cases.situation: The senior partner at my firm, Richard, invited me and my husband out on his boat on Saturday 17 October. We keep weekends for our two kids, and I'd rather not give one up for work, even for him. I'm replying by email.
cases.reply: Thank you for the invitation, Richard, that's very generous of you. We won't be able to join on Saturday the 17th; we keep our weekends for the kids. I hope you get a calm, sunny day out on the water.
cases.note: Saying no up a steep power gap needs no counter-offer: one true reason, and warmth without grovelling. If he asks again, repeat it once.

cases.situation: 大学闺蜜小雨12月19日在泰国清迈办婚礼，邀请我去。机票酒店算下来要七八千，我今年刚换工作，手头紧，去不了。我们是很好的朋友，她1月初回上海，我想等她回来请她和老公吃饭庆祝。
cases.reply: 小雨，收到邀请真的特别开心，谢谢你想着我！清迈这次我去不了，今年刚换工作，手头有点紧。那天我会一直守着你的朋友圈，替你高兴。等你们1月初回上海，我请你和老公吃饭，好好给你们庆祝！
cases.note: 关系很近时，一个真实的理由可以直接说；不提具体金额，免得她提出帮你出钱，再给一个回来后能兑现的庆祝。

cases.situation: My in-laws, Sue and Martin, invited us to spend two weeks with them at a villa they've rented in Mallorca, 10 to 24 July next year. Two weeks away is more than we want, but we'd genuinely love to come for the first four days, 10 to 13 July. I'm replying in the family WhatsApp group.
cases.reply: Sue and Martin, thank you so much for including us, the villa looks wonderful. We won't do the full two weeks, but we'd love to come out for the first four days, 10 to 13 July, if that works for you. Thank you for thinking of us.
cases.note: A partial yes is still a clear no to the main ask: name the part you'll do, with dates, and let the hosts say whether it suits.

cases.situation: My friend Sofia invited me to her housewarming on Saturday 10 October, a big party running till late. I have ME/CFS and a night like that wipes me out for days; she already knows about my illness. I'd love to see the new flat one quiet afternoon over a cup of tea instead.
cases.reply: Thank you for inviting me, Sofia, and congratulations on the new flat! I won't make the party on the 10th; a big late night is more than my ME can manage right now. I'd love to see the place on a quiet afternoon over a cup of tea instead, whenever suits you.
cases.note: When the host already knows about an illness, one plain clause is enough; skip the apology spiral and offer something you can actually do.

cases.situation: It's 10pm and my friend Dani just texted from the pub: 'we're all at the Crown, get down here!' I said I'm in for the night, and she replied 'come on, just one drink, you never come out anymore'. I'm not going, but I'm free Thursday evening and would love to see her properly.
cases.reply: Ha, I really can't tonight, I'm staying in. Have one for me! I'd love a proper catch-up though. Dinner on Thursday?
cases.note: When they push, repeat the no without adding new reasons; a concrete plan answers 'you never come out' better than a defence.

cases.situation: My friend Nadia invited me to dinner at her place on Friday 9 October with her new boyfriend, Greg, and a few others. Last time Greg made comments about my weight all evening, and I don't want to spend another night around him. I'd love to see Nadia on her own, and I'm free for brunch on Saturday 17 October.
cases.reply: Thanks for the invite, Nadia. I'll skip Friday, but I'd love to catch up, just the two of us. Brunch on Saturday the 17th, my treat?
cases.note: The decline doesn't need to name Greg; if you want to raise his comments, do it separately and calmly, not inside a no.

cases.situation: 楼下的张阿姨在电梯里当面邀请我这周日中午去她家吃饭，说她儿子从外地回来，人多热闹。我们平时就在电梯里聊几句，我不想去，但不想让她觉得我冷淡。上次她送我的自家腌的咸菜我特别爱吃，想当场回她。
cases.reply: 谢谢张阿姨，还想着叫上我！周日中午我就不过去了，您一家人好好团聚。上次您给的咸菜特别下饭，我可爱吃了。
cases.note: 当面拒绝更要短：一句谢谢、一句不去、把温度放在她身上；本来就不想去，就不提改天。

cases.situation: 大学室友阿峰10月24日周六在杭州办婚礼，请我去。我爷爷上个月去世了，我们老家的规矩是守孝期间不参加别人的喜事。我想跟他说清楚，红包今天在微信上转给他，等他们度完蜜月回来，我请他和新娘吃饭。
cases.reply: 阿峰，恭喜你们！谢谢你请我。24号的婚礼我去不了：我爷爷上个月走了，我们老家的规矩是守孝期间不参加喜事。红包刚在微信上转给你了，一点心意。等你们度完蜜月回来，我请你和嫂子吃饭，好好给你们庆祝！
cases.note: 关系近，一个真实的理由让他知道不是因为他；不渲染自己的难过，也不再重复道歉。

cases.situation: My husband Dev's oldest friend, Marcus, invited us both to his 50th, a ceilidh in a village hall on Saturday 24 October. Dev will definitely go, but I barely know anyone there and I'd rather have a quiet night in. Marcus has messaged me directly to ask if we're both coming.
cases.reply: Thanks so much for inviting us, Marcus. Dev will definitely be there, but I'm going to sit this one out. Have a brilliant night, and happy 50th!
cases.note: When your partner is going, their yes carries the friendship; your own no can be short, warm and reason-free.

cases.situation: Our uni friends' WhatsApp group (six of us) is planning a ski week in February, and Tom, who's organising, asked everyone to say yes or no by Sunday so he can book the chalet. I started a new job last month and can't take a week off that soon. I'd love to see everyone at a dinner when they're back, and I'm replying in the group, not privately.
cases.reply: Thanks for organising, Tom. I'm a no for the ski week, the new job won't stretch to a week off in February. Have the best time, and count me in for dinner when you're all back.
cases.note: In a group chat, answer the organiser's question in one line so they can count heads; one short true reason, and the warmth goes into the dinner.

cases.situation: My friend Ruth has invited me to three things in a row; I said no to the first two, a gig and her book launch, for real reasons. Now she's asked me to her allotment harvest lunch on Sunday and I genuinely can't go, it's my nephew's christening. I'm worried she'll think I'm avoiding her; I'm free Wednesday evening and would love to have dinner with her.
cases.reply: Thanks for asking me again, Ruth, I really do want to see you. I can't do Sunday, it's my nephew's christening. I know I've missed the last couple of things too, so let me sort the next one: dinner on Wednesday evening?
cases.note: After a run of no's, the concrete plan carries the message; name the pattern once and don't re-explain the earlier declines.

cases.situation: Mi madre, Pilar, tiene alzhéimer avanzado y vive conmigo en Zaragoza. El coro en el que cantó treinta años la ha invitado al concierto de su 50 aniversario, el sábado 24 de octubre, y la directora, Montse, me ha escrito a mí para confirmar. Mi madre no irá, porque un sitio con tanta gente la altera mucho, y me gustaría que el coro supiera que hasta hace poco seguía cantando sus canciones en casa.
cases.reply: Querida Montse, muchas gracias por acordaros de mi madre para el 50 aniversario, me ha emocionado de verdad. Pilar no podrá ir al concierto del sábado 24 de octubre: con el alzhéimer, un sitio con tanta gente la altera mucho. Quiero que sepáis que hasta hace poco seguía cantando vuestras canciones en casa. Os deseo un concierto precioso.
cases.note: Al declinar en nombre de otra persona, basta un motivo breve y verdadero, sin más detalle médico del necesario; el cariño va a lo que el coro significó para ella.

cases.situation: 我在一个线上读书会认识了网友“木子”，我们只在线上聊了半年，从没见过面。她邀请我国庆后去成都玩三天，住她家。我不想去，但还想继续在读书会里聊；下周四晚上的线上读书会我照常参加。
cases.reply: 木子，谢谢你邀请我去成都，还想着让我住你家，这份心意我收到了。这次我就不去了。下周四晚上的读书会我照常来，咱们接着聊。
cases.note: 不想去就不用编理由；以后真想见网友，选白天的公共场所，住自己订的地方，并把行程告诉家人或朋友。
